## Walkthrough

This PR updates performance benchmark metrics in two JSON files. The first file updates ops values for hex parsing benchmarks ("parse hex from char codes" and "parse hex from string nibbles"). The second file reorders benchmark entries where the fastest and slowest bigint decoding benchmark results are swapped. No code logic, structural changes, or error handling modifications are included.
